page.overview:
Who is Nurse Wynn?

Nurse Wynn is a character in , played by Sybil Danning.

She was a nurse at Smith's Grove Sanitarium and was Michael Myers' 5th human victim.

Nurse Wynn worked at Smith's Grove Sanitarium. She was asked to look after ten-year-old Michael Myers for a few minutes while his doctor, Sam Loomis, escorted Michael's mother Deborah downstairs.

Nurse Wynn sat down and looked at the photo of Michael and his baby sister Angel Myers. She commented that the baby was cute and teasingly stated that Michael could not be related to her (the latter remark was left out of the theatrical version). She then turned around and started reading a newspaper.
